description: This file defines the LocalLock class, a tenant singleton for acquiring named locks using SemaphoreSlim, with support for timeouts, expiration, and proper disposal. It implements IDistributedLock, ILocalLock, and IDisposable, and manages internal semaphores with reference counting.

classes.name: LocalLock
classes.description: A singleton class managing named locks for tenants, supporting async lock acquisition, timeouts, expiration, and safe disposal.

classes.name: NamedSemaphore
classes.description: Internal class representing a semaphore with a reference count, used to manage lock instances.

classes.name: Locker
classes.description: Internal class implementing ILocker, representing an acquired lock with expiration support and proper release logic.

methods.name: AcquireLockAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously acquires a named lock, waiting indefinitely until available.

methods.name: TryAcquireLockAsync
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a named lock within a specified timeout, returning success status.

methods.name: IsLockAcquiredAsync
methods.description: Checks if a named lock is currently acquired.

methods.name: GetOrCreateSemaphore
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a semaphore for a given key, managing reference counts.

methods.name: ReleaseReference
methods.description: Decrements the reference count of a semaphore and removes it if no longer in use.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of all semaphores that are not in use, cleaning up resources.
